dedupe_keys.name: alternative fuels data center station locator us and canada fuelling and charging stations

description: The Alternative Fuels Data Center station locator lets users find alternative fuelling and electric vehicle charging stations in the United States and Canada. By default it shows available, publicly accessible stations, and filters expand the search; the site's menus link to data downloads and developer APIs. Coverage: public and other alternative fuel and charging stations in the US and Canada. Format and access: web search and map, with linked downloads and APIs. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the locator page. Caveats: the locator page itself does not give counts, update frequency or field lists. It supports capacity planning of charging networks and emergency response planning, such as fuel availability during evacuations. It relates to the European Alternative Fuels Observatory and the heavy-duty depot charging profiles in the catalogue.
